cases.description: Claims handling standard of a fictional property and motor insurer pasted from a policy document; headings, bullet and numbered lists, a step table and an authority-limits table carry facts that the collapse-then-split import merges into dropped runs.

drafts.label: Claims handler
drafts.caption: Claims handler is kept. Loss registration is executed by Claims handler.

drafts.label: Team leader
drafts.caption: Team leader is kept. Reserve review is approved by Team leader.

drafts.label: Approved engineer
drafts.caption: Approved engineer is kept. Motor assessment is executed by Approved engineer.

drafts.label: Claims surveyor
drafts.caption: Claims surveyor is kept. Property assessment is executed by Claims surveyor.

drafts.label: Loss adjuster
drafts.caption: Loss adjuster is kept. Property assessment is executed by Loss adjuster.

drafts.label: Claims payments team
drafts.caption: Claims payments team is kept. Payment release is executed by Claims payments team.

drafts.label: Senior claims handler
drafts.caption: Senior claims handler is kept. Senior handler authority is held by Senior claims handler.

drafts.label: Claims team leader
drafts.caption: Claims team leader is kept. Team leader authority is held by Claims team leader.

drafts.label: Claims manager
drafts.caption: Claims manager is kept. Claims manager authority is held by Claims manager.

notes.explanation: The handler taking the notification completes registration.
The team leader signs off every reserve review.
An approved engineer carries out motor assessment.
A claims surveyor can carry out property assessment.
A loss adjuster can carry out property assessment.
The settlement table assigns payment release to this team.
The table names the holder of senior handler authority.
The table names the holder of team leader authority.
The table names the holder of claims manager authority.
Names the owner of the claims handling process.
Delegated authority limits handlers' claims decisions.
An open fraud referral suspends settlement.
Triage applies fraud indicators before setting a track.
Automatic payment requires a passed coverage check.
The estimate is attached before repair authorisation.
Photo evidence is attached before repair authorisation.
An offer cannot exceed its maker's delegated authority.
Subrogation uses the liability decision to identify the responsible party.
Total loss evaluation automatically triggers the salvage auction, subject to acceptance and ownership transfer.
The Special Investigations Unit carries out SIU investigations.
The unit reports to the Head of Claims.
The SIU investigation informs the liability decision.
The Head of Claims grants authority in writing.
The table names the holder of desk authority.
Desk authority permits approval of fast track payments.
Senior handler authority permits appointing loss adjusters.
Team leader authority permits sign-off of reserve reviews.
Claims manager authority includes declining claims for fraud.
The table names the Claims Committee as holder.
Document control lists the Head of Claims as owner.
